qti-assessment-item.title: Generate a Data Collection Status Message

section.h2: Generate a Data Collection Status Message
section.pre:
Create a MATLAB script that stores data-collection information and communicates its status in a clear text message. This assessment checks that you can build string scalars from text and numeric data, including conditional singular and plural wording.
1. Leave all provided variables unchanged. 2. Create `statusMessage` using `dataSetName` and `measurementCount`. 3. Create `singleStatusMessage` using `singleDataSetName` and `singleMeasurementCount`. 4. Create `largeStatusMessage` using `largeDataSetName` and `largeMeasurementCount`. 5. Each message must read as `Name: count measurement collected.` for one measurement or `Name: count measurements collected.` otherwise.
Hints: Use `string` to convert a count to text. Choose the word `measurement` or `measurements` based on whether the corresponding count equals one.

qti-item-body.p: Enter the completed MATLAB code for this assessment item.

mgg:metadata.mgg:learning-objective: Use strings to store and communicate textual data.
